> Read the contribution workflow in https://github.com/siriuslatte/lithos/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md before filing.
>
> If this is a usage/support question, start with https://github.com/siriuslatte/lithos/blob/main/SUPPORT.md.
>
> Do not file suspected vulnerabilities in public issues. Use https://github.com/siriuslatte/lithos/blob/main/SECURITY.md instead.

**What type of request is this?**
- [ ] Lithos doesn't support a Roblox feature I would like to use
- [ ] Lithos CLI improvement
- [ ] Docs or contributor workflow improvement
- [ ] Other

**What problem are you trying to solve?**

**What behavior or API shape do you want?**
Describe the config, CLI, or workflow you want Lithos to support.

**What is the smallest workable design?**
If you can, include a sketch of the desired config field, command flag, or preview output.

**What alternatives or workarounds have you tried?**

**Additional context**
Add links, examples, affected resource types, or prior art from Roblox tooling if it helps.
